title: Hunter x Hunter: Yorknew City
synopsis: After reuniting with Gon and his friends, Kurapika explained to them the risks he bears because of his abilities. Believing that his target of revenge is no longer alive and the search for his fallen comrade's eyes could truly begin, Kurapika soon after receives a message informing him that all the Spiders still lived. After much discussion between his friends, Gon, Kurapika and company decided to hunt after the one Spider member who's ability could ultimately result in Kurapika's defeat and death. Based on the manga by Togashi Yoshihiro.

episodes.title: Spider × Corpse × Fake
episodes.synopsis: Kurapika, Gon, Killua and Leorio find out that the Spiders are still alive and that the bodies were fake. The mafia has given up on chasing the Spiders, but Gon and Killua decide to continue to help Kurapika.

episodes.title: Friends × Costumes × Hell's Ear
episodes.synopsis: Kurapika's team set out to find the Phantom Troupe. The Troupe decides to stay and find the chain-user after sensing the location of the nen-copied scarlet eyes.

episodes.title: Pursuit × Escape × Spiders on the Run
episodes.synopsis: A double chase ensues when the Troupe notice Gon and Kurapika following from behind while they chase after the nen-copy of the scarlet eyes. Three of the Spiders confront Gon and Kurapika who are hiding in the shadows.

episodes.title: Hostages × Insignificant Bugs × Communicated Emotions
episodes.synopsis: Killua swaps with Kurapika just in time, Gon and Killua are captured by the Phantom Troupe. The Spiders kill Squala and take his memories of Kurapika. Meanwhile, Gon's group ends up at the hotel where Leorio and Melody have set up a plan.

episodes.title: Report × Darkness × Released Chain
episodes.synopsis: Gon and Killua unsuccessfully attempted an escape. The boss of the Troupe, Chrollo Lucilfer is captured by Kurapika.

episodes.title: Dispute × Break-up × Swinging Fist
episodes.synopsis: Kurapika has captured the leader of the Phantom Troupe, Chrollo Lucilfer. Negotiations are made to exchange him for Killua and Gon.

episodes.title: Exchange × Revenge × Judgment Chain
episodes.synopsis: The exchange is made and the prophecy is fulfilled for Hisoka.

episodes.title: Feelings × Hopelessness × The Spider's Downfall
episodes.synopsis: Since Chrollo's Nen ability was constricted, Hisoka lost interest in the battle with him and revealed that the tattoo of his spider status was fake. Pakunoda transfers her memories to six Troupe members and as a result dies for not obeying the chain's rules.
